content.short: Wizard Crypt is a browser-based RPG on Cardano featuring unique CSS-animated spell NFTs and deep lore.
content.description: Wizard Crypt is a browser-based role-playing game (RPG) built on the Cardano blockchain, blending digital art with interactive exploration. The project is best known for 'Wizard Spellz,' a collection of thousands of uniquely generated, fully on-chain CSS-animated spells that hold in-game utility. Players can explore the crypt, collect rare artifacts, and engage with a lore-driven universe that rewards community participation. By leveraging the security of Cardano's ledger, Wizard Crypt offers a persistent gaming experience where players have true ownership of their digital abilities.
content.meta: Wizard Crypt is a Cardano RPG featuring on-chain CSS-animated spell NFTs and immersive gaming. Explore it on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
